notes.title: Build Patch Notes v1.0.23025
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Newly defeated defectors now can be fought against by everyone![/b] Added ‘All’ option to challenge mode enemy selection. This chooses from everyone’s shared ships, rather than just friends’.
[*]Added paging through friends’ and everyone’s ships (50 at a time).
[*]Added ‘out of scrap’ warning to the shipyard.
[*]Updated the ordering of sub-types in the Direct Control list.
[*]Removed some mid-mission camera cuts and zoom changes.
[*]Fixed Tomahawk Express and Punch Stopper bonuses (and therefore achievements) not working.
[*]Fixed shared ships with fighter decks using the default fighter instead of the one chosen by the creator.
[*]Fixed warp in bugs where it could get stuck warping in forever. Reported as Assault Pig invincible in Survival mode.
[*]Fixed Runaway crashing into asteroids.
[*]Fixed Stash crashing into asteroids on hard difficulty in Stash mission.
[*]Fixed Carriers mission black screen if die after carrier gets away.
[/list]

notes.title: Build Patch Notes v1.0.22924
notes.content:

[*]No longer in Early Access!
[*]Localised into French, Italian, German, Spanish and Russian!
[*]Hooked up friends option in challenge mode.
[*]Added the final two missions.

[*]Fixed being able to get into challenge mode before any pieces have been unlocked.
[*]Sound fixes for being zoomed out while using hyper core ships.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.12.21690
notes.content:
Quite a big early christmas present...

-Unlocked 40+ Super class components at the end of Station Attack level, including the first Super Core! Beware that the stats and abilities of Super components might change a lot in the coming months, so your ships that use them might get broken.
-Added new Level, Gloves Off. Also unlocks Green Core
-Added ship break up. Components now drift apart when ships are destroyed.
-Fixed tractor beam collision
-Fixed power and crew stats to round down on the graph, so you don’t get unexplained jumps from 1 to -1
-Fixed long pause wait on exiting the game.
-Changed Scrap acceleration to make tractor beam more useful.
